sentences.text: Incisoscutum is a genus of armored fish belonging to the class Placodermi.
This animal is part of the family Camuropiscidae.
The genus contains two species, one named after a scientist and the other after his daughter.
Evidence from these fossils indicates that live birth was common among early jawed vertebrates.
Its jaw structure suggests it fed on hard-shelled prey.
Finding many individuals together implies the fish might have swum in groups.
They likely lived in stable warm reefs that offered safe hiding spots for pregnant mothers.
These creatures lived during the Frasnian stage, from 382.31 to 372.15 million years ago.
